exact-identifier.scope: lookup by CELEX, ELI, ECLI, doknr, docket or official ID
exact-identifier.basis: deterministic identity match; not a relevance claim

exact-locator-or-substring.scope: passages of one chosen version by locator fragment or exact substring
exact-locator-or-substring.basis: deterministic filter inside one version; not a relevance ranking

lexical-bm25.basis: no accepted independent human-judged legal evaluation

semantic.basis: no accepted independent human-judged legal evaluation

hybrid.basis: no accepted independent human-judged legal evaluation

reranked.basis: no accepted independent human-judged legal evaluation

evidence_note: Existing runs used publisher-identifier and exact-membership labels; they cannot enable a mode.
